doc.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007

title: Recording the James P. Johnson concert
summary: Rayhill recorded James P. Johnson at the 1940s Hamilton concert; the tape went to the library and some tracks were later bootlegged on LP.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Right. Wasn’t there, someone said that that might have been recorded or something?
And I gave the tape to the so-called library at that time. And it’s around here somewhere.
All right. I’m going to have to track that down. © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-
Yeah. In fact two of the records showed up on an LP, oh probably in the middle seventies. It showed one was bootlegged so it’s floating around.
